title: enigoma machine configuration (schema v2)
description: Complete configuration of an enigoma machine, including current rotor positions. Produced by Machine.Settings and accepted by ParseSettings (enigoma >= 0.7).

alphabet.description: Characters the machine operates on: unique, even count (the reflector pairs every character).

wiring.description: Permutation of the alphabet: output character for each input character, in alphabet order.

notches.description: Characters at which this rotor turns over the rotor to its left; may be empty.

ring.description: Ring setting (one alphabet character); empty means the first character.

position.description: Rotor position shown in the window (one alphabet character); empty means the first character.

fixed.description: The rotor never steps (M4 thin rotors Beta and Gamma).

wiring.description: Reciprocal mapping of the alphabet with no character mapped to itself.

plugboard.description: Space-separated plugboard pairs, e.g. "AB CD". Empty for no pairs.
